svg.text: Data and semantic foundation: what the agents actually stand on
Three operational stores feed the runs directly; the Fabric side gives the same universe a governed semantic shape that agents can query in natural language.
OPERATIONAL · read/write on every run
Bundled corpus (per use case)
25 synthetic claims + 13 loan applications with realistic shape: policyholders, policies,
vehicles, incidents, flags. Ships inside the package resources; defines the id pattern
usecases/*/data/*.json → Resources/
Runtime intake (Cosmos · intake)
Every claim or application filed through the portals, stored durably with the server-
assigned subject id and the embedded photo evidenceAssessment. Merges with the
corpus on read, so new subjects are queued and runnable instantly
Evidence store (Blob · evidence container)
Damage photos uploaded at FNOL, grouped per submission with a subject alias for
read-side resolution. Served back to the tracker and Decision Mode by the API
{groupId}/photo-N.jpg · subjects/{subjectId}
Decision journal (Cosmos · dw-state)
The immutable output side: every run's steps, citations, gates, and judgments.
Aggregated live into Outcomes, never rewritten
SEMANTIC · Microsoft Fabric (Fabric IQ)
Gold lakehouse, 24 tables
A dimensional model generated from the same synthetic universe: dim_policyholder,
dim_vehicle, fact_claims, dim_borrower, fact_loan_applications, plus the claims-domain
entities (loss events, coverages, payments, fraud indicators, visual evidence...)
Ontology over the gold layer
Entity and relationship definitions that give the tables business meaning; agent steps
record which ontology entities a decision touched (ontologyBindings on the journal)
Published Data Agent · claims_data_agent
Answers natural-language questions over the ontology + semantic model. The platform
consults it once per subject (FabricDataAgentSource) and cites the answer per step.
every call: ?api-version=2024-05-01-preview · assistant minted via POST /assistants
Loaders + generators, reproducible
usecases/*/data/fabric-gold-generator produces the CSVs; loader scripts land them in
the lakehouse. The whole semantic side rebuilds from the repo
ONE UNIVERSE, TWO SHAPES
The record a run reasons over and the tables the Data Agent queries describe the same subjects, so a grounded answer from Fabric IQ genuinely
corroborates (or contradicts) the operational record. That is what makes the citations meaningful rather than decorative.
same universe
